answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each participant to post a unique orbital slot bond anchored to a verifiable burn history, making identity replication as costly as reserving a distinct marble in a shared harbor registry. Colluders who clone identities to game rendezvous scheduling are detected when their overlapping thruster burn windows exceed a willow-thin. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
